name: terminal_anchored_occupancy_policy_improvement
novelty: One-step incumbent-policy advantages calibrated against the unchanged terminal decoder, with exact own-law incumbent occupancy weighting; not another 3-bias grid and not full-optimal-Q uniform MSE.

inputs.incumbent: fixed previously published C continuation head
inputs.representation: 85 input to tanh48; fixed Belief row, input weights and law
inputs.historical_exclusion: all available 1936 old unique schedules plus prior followup 480 unique schedules; also check duplicates across all new holdouts
inputs.historical_unknowns: unknown external trials and unavailable original formal-confirmation content remain unexcluded; historical compute cost not recoverable is unknown

candidate_construction.information: original TRAIN public schedules and checkpoint own transition/emission law only; no evaluator truth posterior, Q, or outcomes
candidate_construction.state_key: complete serialized state including sunk charges, not merged Markov representation
candidate_construction.teacher: Q_C(s,a) = expected immediate reward plus continuation with fixed C; all transitions enumerated exactly in floating-point order
candidate_construction.terminal_anchor: a_T(s)=first argmax of unchanged C decoder over legal STOP and SUBMIT actions; T_pred = decoder score; T_own = own-law expected payoff of a_T; Y_a = T_pred + Q_C(s,a) - T_own
candidate_construction.occupancy: exact own-law state occupancy of C; per world mixture 0.9 normalized incumbent occupancy + 0.1 uniform full support, then uniform legal continuation actions
candidate_construction.objective: weighted squared error to anchored one-step targets plus 1e-4 squared change; same known exact-F64 norm limit 0.5*||C_Q||
candidate_construction.solver: direct spectral trust-region solve; matched projected-gradient solve of identical quadratic, start, radius and stopping tolerance
candidate_construction.selection: per fit maximum full own-law TRAIN expected utility along stored-F64 path; ties choose smaller alpha. Includes exact no-edit alpha0. No mathematical claim beyond this fixed finite set.

arms.kind: matched-information gradient solution and same finite path
same anchored one-step target with uniform full-support weighting
same occupancy-mixture weighting but unanchored raw one-step Q_C target
previous frozen DQ old uniform full-optimal-Q MSE model, no new tuning
single preseeded norm-matched random continuation edit, no search
zero-weight-edit C with own-law analytic terminal posterior, program control
zero-weight-edit full own-law Bellman program control

freeze_order: all fit candidate weights and all TRAIN selection results
holdout_design.validation_gate: equal-domain mean E/G improvement versus C >=0.005 and neither domain negative, per fit; otherwise byte-equivalent C restored
holdout_design.confidence: five paired fit differences; Student-t df4, Bonferroni across two predeclared primary contrasts; both lower bounds must exceed0.005
holdout_design.secondary: all raw and gated arms, behavior, proxy loss, selected alphas and compute; report descriptive only; no holdout optimization
holdout_design.sampling_limitation: same five training fits; new scenarios are not new independently trained models; non-overlap does not prove statistical independence

not_claimed: recovered cost of unknown historical runs

scope_limits: no repeated adaptive candidate search after failure
no stronger claim from solver certificates or proxy loss reduction
